title: Wait For It
description: Count ways to hold a button to beat boat race distance records.
writeup:
## Approach

The distance traveled for a hold time `h` in a race of duration `T` is `h * (T - h)`. We need to count how many integer values of `h` give a distance strictly greater than the record `D`.

## Part 1

Solve the quadratic inequality `h * (T - h) > D` for each race. The roots of `h^2 - Th + D = 0` give the boundary, and we count the integers strictly between them. Multiply the win counts across all races.

## Part 2

Concatenate all times and distances into single large numbers to form one big race. The same quadratic formula works instantly regardless of the magnitude.
